novel_features.name: Generic company
novel_features.description: Lever public postings are per-company: any company's careers page under jobs.lever.co is addressable with the company slug as a positional argument, so the CLI works for every Lever employer without per-company configuration.

novel_features.name: Company-scoped offline sync
novel_features.description: Sync a company's public postings into a local SQLite store for offline reads, filtering, and later agent workflows, scoped to the requested company.
